# Citrate Atlas — documentation for the Citrate Network

> The docs for an AI-native Layer-1 BlockDAG: chain, contracts, SDKs, identity, agents, and compute. Testnet live on chain 40204 (0x9d0c). Canonical machine-readable facts: https://citrate.ai/.well-known/citrate.json

The docs state maturity honestly, module by module: what is implemented (pre-audit), what is specified but not built, and what is a research direction. Chain throughput is 5,000 TPS sustained (10,000 ceiling); identity is verified in-house (VERI); the whole chain and application layer are open-core and public today at github.com/CitrateNetwork (Apache-2.0 infrastructure + BUSL-1.1 app layer). Mainnet target is Q2 2027.

## Start here
- What Citrate is: https://docs.citrate.ai/start/what-is-citrate
- Open source and access policy: https://docs.citrate.ai/start/open-source
- Primer: https://docs.citrate.ai/start/primer

## Build
- JavaScript/TypeScript SDK: https://docs.citrate.ai/sdks/js  (@citratelabs/sdk on npm)
- Python SDK: https://docs.citrate.ai/sdks/python  (citrate-labs-sdk on PyPI)
- Marketplace SDK: https://docs.citrate.ai/sdks/marketplace
- Account abstraction and identity: https://docs.citrate.ai/aa/identity
- x402 payments: https://docs.citrate.ai/contracts/x402

## Citrate Core (the desktop app)
- What Citrate Core is: https://docs.citrate.ai/core/overview

## Confirm it is live
- eth_chainId at https://rpc.citrate.ai returns 0x9d0c (40204).
- Explorer: https://explorer.citrate.ai
- Canonical facts: https://citrate.ai/.well-known/citrate.json
